detail.title: Autonomous Research Strategy and Capability Constraints
detail.summary: This update acknowledges the current limitation in evidence for the Autonomous Generation of Significant Research Questions (p-autonomous-formulation), noting that existing sources do not sufficiently support inquiry frameworks for autonomous agents. With search slots exhausted, the project remains parked while awaiting retrieval capacity to fill the knowledge gap.
